turns: So, what do you think are the main substances that contribute to air pollution today?

Yes, those substances are definitely major contributors to air pollution. But I also believe that other substances such as volatile organic compounds (VOCs) and heavy metals like lead and mercury can also contribute to air pollution.

There are several things that individuals and society can do to improve air quality. Additionally, individuals can make conscious choices to purchase environmentally-friendly products, like those with low VOCs or those made with sustainable materials. On a larger scale, governments and industries can invest in renewable energy sources and implement stricter regulations on industrial emissions.
